title: deaddrop: add_drop evicts live drops before validating explicit drop_id
description: rust/lichen-client/src/deaddrop.rs:999-1008: evict_for_space() runs before params.drop_id canonical/uniqueness validation; a request with invalid or duplicate explicit ID returns None AFTER evicting unexpired live drops (expired-then-oldest FIFO). A rejected create destroys other users' data. Spec 18.9 eviction is meant to admit a stored drop, not fire on doomed requests. post() is safe (fallible checks precede eviction). Fix: hoist canonical-ID/uniqueness check above evict_for_space; add regression test (fill store to capacity, add_drop with drop_id Some(nothex), assert no live drop vanished).
close_reason: Hoisted explicit drop_id canonical/uniqueness validation above evict_for_space in add_drop (rust/lichen-client/src/deaddrop.rs): a doomed request (non-canonical or duplicate ID) now returns None before any eviction, per spec 18.9 (eviction admits a stored drop, never fires on doomed requests). Regression test add_drop_doomed_explicit_id_preserves_live_drops fills a capacity-sized store, fires invalid/duplicate explicit-ID requests, asserts the live drop survives, and confirms FIFO eviction still works for an admissible request. Verified: cargo test -p lichen-client --lib (130 passed) + --test deaddrop_vectors (23 passed, was 22 + 1 new). Commit 31e1ed25c6.
